items.zh: 但到了19世纪末，那个时代已经结束了。
items.en: But by the end of the 19th century, that era had come to a close.

items.zh: 这座北方冰城面对突如其来的大批游客，一时无所适从。
items.en: A large number of sudden tourists’ arrival left the northern icy caught off guard.

items.zh: 汉字并非简单的符号，而是图像的组合，能让读者联想到自然万物。
items.en: Instead of simple symbols, Chinese characters are a combination of images, allowing readers to associate with all things in nature.

items.zh: 即使少量摄入也会损害年轻人的大脑，并可能增加心脏问题的风险。
items.en: Ingesting even small quantities damages young brains and may raise the risk of heart problems.

items.zh: 由于长期坚持阅读经典名著，她不仅拓宽了知识面，还培养了批判性思维能力。
items.en: She has not only broadened her knowledge, but also fostered her critical thinking ability as a result of long-term exposure to classic literature.

items.zh: 这座主题乐园中的24口钟均未显示正确时间，游客感到时间停滞，因而沉醉于游览体验中。
items.en: All the twenty-four clocks in the theme park don’t show the correct time so that the visitors feel time stand still and are absorbed in the experience.

items.zh: 年轻人借助多媒体和直播，打破了销售时空的限制，让农产品走出乡村，进入更大的市场。
items.en: Through multimedia and livestreaming, young people have broken the time and space barriers to sales, enabliing the agricultural products from rural areas to reach much larger markets.
